title: Rapid generation of functional mature pancreatic islet-beta cells from human pluripotent stem cells
protocol: Coat 10 cm dishes with 5 ml of 0.1% Gelatin.
Incubate the coated dishes at room temperature for at least 30 minutes.
Take a new cryovial of MEFs from liquid nitrogen and keep on dry ice until thawed.
Warm the vial in a 37°C water bath until approximately half the ice has thawed.
Transfer the cells to a 15 ml falcon tube containing 5 ml of warm MEF media.
Centrifuge the cells at 1000 rpm for 3 minutes.
Aspirate gelatin from the 10 cm dishes.
Distribute 570k MEFs per 10 cm dish and place in an incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Aspirate spent media from highly confluent hESC cultures on 10 cm dishes.
Wash with 5 ml of PBS-/-.
Add 2 ml of trypLE to the cells and incubate for 6-8 minutes.
Quench the reaction by adding 8 ml of hESC media once the cells dislodge.
Centrifuge the cells at 1000 rpm for 3 minutes.
Aspirate MEF media from plates.
Distribute hESC cells at 4.3x10^6 cells/10 cm on Tuesdays.
Distribute hESC cells at 3.17x10^6 cells/10 cm on Fridays.
Feed the cells everyday with hESC media.
Passage hESC cultures using TrypLE.
Count and seed cells at 5.5x10^6 cells/well in 6-well suspension plates.
Place the plates in the incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2 on an orbital shaker at 100 rpm to induce 3D sphere formation.
Check for sphere formation after 24 hours.
Collect the spheres in 50 ml falcon tubes and allow them to settle by gravity for 3 minutes.
Wash once with PBS++.
Aspirate PBS++.
Resuspend the spheres in day 1 media.
Distribute the resuspended spheres into fresh 6-well suspension plates at 5.5ml/well.
Place the plates back on the shaker in the incubator.
Aspirate 5 ml of spent media until day 3.
Replenish with 5.5 ml of respective day media.
Aspirate 4.5 ml of spent media from cell cultures starting on day 4.
Feed with 5 ml of prescribed media for the respective day.
On day 20, collect spheres and incubate with Accumax for 8 minutes (1.5 ml Accumax per well).
Flick the tube every 2 minutes to allow efficient dissociation.
Sort live GFP-high cells on Aria II at low flow rates (<3000 events/sec).
Collect sorted cells and resuspend in day 20-27 media with 10 μM Rock inhibitor (1 × 10^6 cells/1.5 ml).
Dispense 1.5 ml of cell suspension into each well of AggrewellTM-400 plates, ensuring there are 1000 cells per cluster.
Incubate Aggrewell plates for 48 hours at 37°C and 5% O2 or until cells have aggregated into nicely round clusters.
Transfer the resulting clusters into a 6-well suspension plate in 3 ml of day 20-27 media.
Culture the clusters until the end of differentiation (day 27), refreshing the medium every third day.
Clusters can be used until day 30.
